    if mode == "pursuit_evasion" or observation.get("type") == "pursuit_evasion":

            if dx not in (-1, 0, 1): dx = 0
            if dy not in (-1, 0, 1): dy = 0
            return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control or fallback: move toward center of grid when possible
